snippet.title: CATACLYSM | Cinematic Trailer Part 1 | Hearthstone
snippet.description:
In the final moments of Across the Timeways, Murozond refused to accept defeat from Chromie and the Heroes of Time. At the brink of defeat, he smashed the Hourglass of Time and opened a portal to a nightmare timeline where Deathwing had never been defeated.
